mechanism.claim: A high-variation completed eight-hour BTC path with many more positive than negative one-minute returns beyond its own RMS scale, or the exact symmetric negative breadth, reflects repeated one-sided tail price discovery rather than one dominant jump. Follow the tail-breadth direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of positive-tail count minus negative-tail count
mechanism.why_distinct: HVSTBR counts RMS-standardized positive and negative return exceedances. Realized skew weights cubic magnitudes; semivariance compares squared mass; sign-run and entropy candidates use every return's sign and ordering; median breadth ignores tail scale; dominant-shock candidates localize one largest move. HVSTBR uses no volume, flow, funding, OI, cross-assets, prior event rows, fitted outcomes, or controls.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed realized variation must occupy its causal upper regime, while the tail-breadth share must independently occupy its causal upper quartile
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: three fixed UTC standardized-tail breadth onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.block: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows in [D-8h,D)
features.tail_breadth: positive-tail count minus negative-tail count, strict nonzero
features.tail_breadth_share: abs(tail_breadth)/(positive-tail count+negative-tail count), strict positive denominator
features.causal_ranks: strict-prior midranks of tail-breadth share and realized variation over at most 270 earlier source-valid blocks, minimum 180; current excluded
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid block ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.side: sign of completed standardized tail breadth
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no formula, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, comparator, or control repair.
